@Test
public void givenExistingEntitiesWhenExecutingGetCommandThenExpectTheCorrectRdf() throws Exception {
    final RestTester restTester = module.newObject(RestTester.class);
    final String result = restTester.getEntities();
    assertThat("Returned RDF", result, anyOf(equalTo("<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rdf:RDF
	xmlns="urn:qi4j:"
	xmlns:qi4j="http://www.qi4j.org/rdf/model/1.0/"
	xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#"
	xmlns:rdfs="http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#">
<qi4j:entity rdf:about="/entity/P2.rdf"/>
</rdf:RDF>
"), equalTo("<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone=\"no\"?>
<rdf:RDF
	xmlns="urn:qi4j:"
	xmlns:qi4j="http://www.qi4j.org/rdf/model/1.0/"
	xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#"
	xmlns:rdfs="http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#">
<qi4j:entity rdf:about="/entity/P2.rdf"/>
</rdf:RDF>
"), equalTo("<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rdf:RDF
	xmlns="urn:qi4j:"
	xmlns:qi4j="http://www.qi4j.org/rdf/model/1.0/"
	xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#"
	xmlns:rdfs="http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#">
<qi4j:entity rdf:about="/entity/P2.rdf"/>
<qi4j:entity rdf:about="/entity/P1.rdf"/>
</rdf:RDF>
"), equalTo("<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone=\"no\"?>
<rdf:RDF
	xmlns="urn:qi4j:"
	xmlns:qi4j="http://www.qi4j.org/rdf/model/1.0/"
	xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#"
	xmlns:rdfs="http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#">
<qi4j:entity rdf:about="/entity/P2.rdf"/>
<qi4j:entity rdf:about="/entity/P1.rdf"/>
</rdf:RDF>
")));
}
